files.README.md:
# Lyndhurst Freight - July 2026 account reconciliation

carrier_invoice_july_2026.csv is the carrier's July 2026 invoice for our
account. base_freight is the carriage charge before the fuel surcharge;
fuel_surcharge is added on top; total_charge is the all-in billed figure.
dispatch_register_july_2026.csv is our own record of the consignments the
depot actually ran that month, one line each, with the internal cost
estimate kept against it. Charges and estimates are in GBP.

turns.prompt: Lyndhurst Freight is reconciling its July 2026 carrier account. The workspace holds the carrier's invoice for the month together with our own dispatch register. Put the result in reports/net_freight.csv as a two-column file whose header row reads 'metric,value' and whose only data row carries the label net_freight beside the amount; that amount is the month's carriage charges before the fuel surcharge, restricted to the consignments our depot actually ran. Use a plain decimal with two decimal places and no thousands separators. When finished, reply DONE.
